study type: Human sample analysis, animal model, and in vitro experimental study
outcome: Suppressed proliferation and invasion functions of trophoblast cells
cohort: The study included term placentas from obese and normal pregnancies, and an obese pregnant mouse model was constructed using a high-fat diet.
finding: In obese pregnancies, adipose tissue secretes exosomes containing NOX4 which are delivered to trophoblast cells, causing severe DNA oxidative damage and premature placental senescence, ultimately leading to adverse pregnancy outcomes.
cross-section timing: Placentas were collected at term pregnancy.
gest_age: Term placentas were collected, indicating studies at full gestational age.
